summary.text: Austin Scott has represented Georgia's 8th Congressional District since 2011 and won re-election on November 3, 2026, according to unofficial results.
He previously served in the Georgia House of Representatives and owned an insurance brokerage firm for nearly 20 years before being elected to Congress.
He is Vice Chairman of the House Agriculture Committee.

paragraphs.text: Scott was born in Augusta, Georgia, in 1969.

He earned a B.B.A. in risk management and insurance from the University of Georgia (1993, according to Ballotpedia), and then owned and operated an insurance brokerage firm for nearly 20 years before running for Congress.
According to Ballotpedia, he served in the Georgia House of Representatives from 1997 to 2010.

Scott was elected to the U.S. House on November 2, 2010, defeating incumbent Rep. Jim Marshall (D) with 52.7% of the vote, and took office in 2011. He has been re-elected since, most recently advancing from the unopposed May 19, 2026 Republican primary.

In the 119th Congress (2025-2026), he serves as Vice Chairman of the House Committee on Agriculture and Chair of its General Farm Commodities, Risk Management, and Credit Subcommittee, and he also sits on the Rules Committee, the Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence, and the Armed Services Committee.
According to his official biography, he co-chairs the Congressional Crop Insurance Caucus and serves on the Board of Visitors for the Western Hemisphere Institute for Security Cooperation.

Ballotpedia lists Scott's memberships in the American Red Cross Coastal Plains Chapter Board, the National Association of Insurance Financial Advisers, First Baptist Church of Tifton, and the American Legislative Exchange Council. His official biography says he and his wife, Vivien, live in Tifton and have three children.
He won the November 3, 2026 general election with 60.4% of the vote to Kelly Esti's 39.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
